title: Tally and Power BI Integration
seoTitle: Tally Power BI Integration: Live Dashboards From Tally Data
seoDescription: Build Power BI dashboards on TallyPrime data: sales, receivables, stock and margins, refreshed automatically. Connection methods, set-up and limits.
summary: A Tally–Power BI integration extracts sales, purchases, receivables, stock and ledger data from TallyPrime on a schedule and feeds Power BI dashboards, so owners see current figures by branch, product and customer without waiting for month-end reports.

dataPoints.label: Tally side
dataPoints.value: ODBC or XML export via a connector, often into an intermediate database

dataPoints.label: Power BI side
dataPoints.value: Scheduled refresh through the on-premises data gateway or from a cloud database

dataPoints.label: Typical dashboards
dataPoints.value: Sales trend, receivables ageing, stock value and movement, margin by product

dataPoints.label: Refresh
dataPoints.value: Daily or several times a day, depending on licence and design

body:
## Recommended design

Rather than connecting Power BI straight to Tally, copy Tally data into a small database on a schedule. Dashboards then load faster, history is kept, and Tally is not slowed down.

## Start with decisions

Build dashboards around the decisions they support: what to chase, what to reorder, which products earn money. See [building a dashboard your leadership team will actually use](/blog/building-a-dashboard-your-leadership-team-will-actually-use).

faqs.q: Do I need Power BI Pro?
faqs.a: Sharing dashboards with colleagues generally needs paid licences; check current Microsoft licensing.

faqs.q: Can this combine Tally with other systems?
faqs.a: Yes, a central database can combine Tally with CRM, e-commerce and operations data.
